q: The Bogdanov-Takens bifurcation occurs when the Jacobian at equilibrium has:
opts: A pair of purely imaginary eigenvalues
A zero eigenvalue with algebraic multiplicity 1
A double zero eigenvalue (a Jordan block)
All eigenvalues with negative real parts
exp: Bogdanov-Takens: the Jacobian has eigenvalue 0 with algebraic multiplicity 2 (Jordan block 2×2). The unfolding generically contains saddle-node, Hopf, and homoclinic bifurcations.
